verdict.rationale: The plugins docs show `ultrametric init --dry-run --json` previewing changes before a second command 'writes the selected skill files', and the CLI can add instructions for Codex and Claude Code. This implies some selection at install time, but it is unclear whether a developer can pick individual skills from the collection or only choose the target agent host. missing for 10: explicit documentation of choosing individual skills from a catalog, a list of the available skills, per-skill install/uninstall commands, and independent or hands-on confirmation of selective install.
